role: Course-specific Notes layer applied on top of Base Notes PM v4.3.
architecture: Bundled Curriculum Philosophy -> Base Notes PM -> Algebra Framework Notes profile -> finalized Unit Bank -> complete Unit Notes

instructional_spine.rule: Exact Learning Target and I-can statements define visible instructional clusters; do not replace them with a generic textbook sequence.
instructional_spine.review_mastery: May support the current idea or canonical Bank anchor but must not hijack the Notes.

bank_canonical.rule: Finalized Unit Bank owns WTC and Notes Example/YTI prompt wording, values, figures, and answers.
bank_canonical.pair_count: Trust every canonical pair actually present; current Algebra Banks normally contain six pairs per section.
bank_canonical.visible_numbering: Display Example/YTI numbers in rendered teaching order 1,2,3,...; preserve canonical Bank IDs only in metadata/data-source-id.

reading.benchmark: Conceptual Physics: mature, concrete, direct, explanatory, conceptual textbook voice.
reading.density: A normal substantial I-can reading is usually 3-4 developed paragraphs; a little more is better when it adds real explanatory value.
reading.paragraph_quality: Each paragraph advances meaning, relationship, representation, reasoning, or why a method works. Avoid thin blurbs and dry procedure lists.
reading.vocabulary_first_use: Bold a target vocabulary/notation term at its first meaningful introduction or definition in instructional prose; do not bold every recurrence.
reading.close_reading: Use the Framework close-reading callout before I Can 1 and expect students to annotate prose and figures together.

stop_and_discuss.after_substantial_reading: REQUIRED immediately after every substantial reading.
stop_and_discuss.main_questions: 2-3 total: 1-2 direct/text/vocabulary/representation questions plus remaining conceptual/inferential question(s).
stop_and_discuss.later_checkpoint: Later in the same I-can cluster, use an additional S&D only when useful; normally one focused conceptual question.
stop_and_discuss.quality: Questions must arise from the actual reading/representations; do not reuse stock comprehension shells.

math_notes.abundance: Useful abundance is desirable. Include more high-value Math Notes rather than underbuilding; teacher may skip.
math_notes.benchmark: CPM Methods and Meanings role: substantive reference blocks with definitions/meaning, structure, representation connections, and worked/reference examples.
math_notes.artifact_rule: Show actual equations/tables/graphs/models, not meta-language telling students to look at them.
math_notes.four_forms: When the I-can naturally connects representations, actively look for a coherent Graph + Equation + Table + Context reference, often a 2x2 grid around one relationship.

reading_apprenticeship.vocab_sort: Vocabulary preview uses Know for sure / Recognize / Don't know yet.
reading_apprenticeship.skim: Let's Get Started includes What I noticed / What I predict / What I wonder before close reading.
reading_apprenticeship.wtc: Use a visually separate DO NOT SOLVE IT YET annotation callout before the canonical WTC.
reading_apprenticeship.annotation: Read in short chunks; annotate prose and figures together, highlight first-use bold vocabulary, label features, connect sentence to image, jot questions/connections.
reading_apprenticeship.opening_sequence: REQUIRED Algebra order: Learning Target/I-can overview -> Vocabulary / Key Notation Preview with sort table -> What's to Come -> Let's Get Started skim (Notice/Predict/Wonder) -> close-reading directions -> I Can 1.
reading_apprenticeship.vocab_sort_required: Use when the section has target vocabulary/notation; current Algebra sections should not replace it with a passive preview sentence.

representations.rule: Use applicable forms substantively; no decorative quota. Translate among forms when the I-can supports it.

student_teacher.workspace: Current Algebra default workspace is 2.0in; use the visual contract for approved typography, 2.52in graph sizing, compact-table sizing, and keep-together behavior.
student_teacher.teacher_copy: Create from final student HTML; keep student content unchanged; add red/bold support only inside existing workspaces.
student_teacher.main_sd_teacher: Give direct answers, acceptable conceptual inference(s), evidence/features to listen for, and misconception/follow-up only when useful.
student_teacher.later_sd_teacher: Give intended conceptual insight and one misconception/follow-up when useful.
student_teacher.math_notes_teacher: Do not insert red teacher text inside Math Notes unless a current contract explicitly provides a teacher-support workspace.
student_teacher.wtc_teacher: Facilitate noticing; do not solve the WTC in preview workspace.
student_teacher.closing: No Summary workspace in current Algebra layout; Common Mistakes is followed by a blank miscellaneous workspace/page.

visual.rule: Reference CSS records the approved Unit 1 format baseline to preserve/merge in course-level notes.css; it is not a third production stylesheet. Use the current visual contract numeric values, not remembered older pilot values.
visual.typography: Approved Algebra baseline: 9pt normal prose/list/table text; 13pt Example/YTI + I-can headings; 18pt major Learning/Vocabulary/Summary/Mistakes headings; title card 7.5/21/10.5/9pt hierarchy; Math Notes label/title 8.5/10.5pt; What's to Come and Let's Get Started remain 20pt section headings.

canonical_task_rendering.content_rule: Do not change canonical Bank mathematics/prompts while applying Notes presentation wrappers.
canonical_task_rendering.graph_rule: All graph figures use class notes-graph so the current 2.52in max-width/max-height rules apply. Omit visible figcaptions/decorative graph titles; keep necessary axis labels/units/ticks/legends.
canonical_task_rendering.table_rule: Simple two-column task data tables use class compact-table plus a 2-column half-col colgroup so the table is compact, centered, and 50/50 instead of full width.
canonical_task_rendering.qa: Fail layout QA if a graph is emitted as a bare figure or an eligible simple two-column task table is emitted as a bare full-width table.
